en.t: In this life, we have no fate together.”

units.source_text: 源氏大将看了，想道：“她的手笔并不纤丽，然而功夫很深，草书尤其漂亮。

en.t: General Genji looked at it and thought, “Her handwriting is not delicate, but it shows deep skill, and her cursive script is especially beautiful.

units.source_text: 料想她年华渐长，容颜定然更增艳丽吧。”

en.t: As she grows older, her face must surely become even more lovely.”

units.source_text: 此心一动，自知亵渎神明，不免有些惶恐。

en.t: Once this thought stirred in him, he knew he was profaning the gods and could not help feeling somewhat afraid.

units.source_text: 他回想在野宫访晤六条妃子那个感伤的秋夜，正是去年今日；

en.t: He recalled that melancholy autumn night when he had visited Lady Rokujo at the shrine in the fields; it had been exactly this day last year.

units.source_text: 不料今秋又有类似之事，却也奇妙。

en.t: Unexpectedly, this autumn had brought a similar matter again, which was strange as well.

units.source_text: 他怨恨神明妨碍他的恋爱，此种习癖实甚恶劣。

en.t: He resented the gods for hindering his love affairs; this habit of his was truly very bad.

units.source_text: 他又回想：当年如果执意追求，未始不能到手；

en.t: He also thought back that, if he had insisted on pursuing her then, it was not impossible that he might have won her.

units.source_text: 那时等闲放过，今日甚是后悔。

en.t: Having let the chance pass lightly at the time, he now regretted it deeply.
Such thoughts, too, were truly very absurd.

units.source_text: 斋院也知道源氏有此种怪癖，所以偶尔给他回信时，并不严词拒绝。

en.t: The High Priestess also knew that Genji had this strange tendency, so when she occasionally answered his letters, she did not reject him in harsh words.
This, too, was somewhat hard to understand.
